visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair and straight bangs, wearing a dark blue sleeveless collared shirt and a delicate necklace, stands inside a brightly lit Japanese drugstore. She looks directly at the camera, talking and gesturing with her hands. The background is filled with rows of skincare and cosmetic products on white shelving units with bright overhead fluorescent lighting. (2) She holds up a packaged KISSME mascara remover, displaying both a blue version and a pink version to the lens. The camera focuses on the product packaging which features an illustration of a woman's eye and Japanese text. She brings the product close to the camera for detail. (3) The scene shifts to her standing in a different aisle, this time surrounded by boxes of medicinal patches. She points toward the shelves behind her. She then holds up a black and blue box of Hisamitsu Feitas 5.0 pain relief patches, showing the front of the box clearly. (4) She transitions to showing a larger blue and white box of Salonpas patches, holding it up with both hands while continuing to speak. The background remains the shelves of a pharmacy. (5) She holds up a single small silver and black foil sachet of the patches, indicating she carries them with her. (6) In the final segment, she places her hand on her neck and leans her head back and to the side, exhibiting a facial expression of mild discomfort or physical strain, as if demonstrating a stiff neck.
